bio: Part of the highly attractive Kamezí Boutique Villas complex, this iconic space boasts attractive views that bring added personality to the dining experience, which is enhanced by the gourmet boutique. The striking display counter showcases its top-quality ingredients (the staff are happy to provide details on their suppliers from Lanzarote and across the Canaries), including bread baked on the premises. The creative cuisine, based around local flavours and ingredients, is centred on a single tasting menu entitled Bernegal (a large primitive ceramic plate typical of the Canaries), featuring dishes such as squid with a lemon and chilli pepper pilpil, avocado, cauliflower and chocolate. The archipelago also takes centre-stage on the wine list and cheese trolley!...
